#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> first_part, second_part;
    int mid = n / 2;

    function<void(int, int)> generate_first = [&](int i, int total) {
        if (i == mid) {
            first_part.push_back(total);
        } else {
            generate_first(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            generate_first(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    function<void(int, int)> generate_second = [&](int i, int total) {
        if (i == n) {
            second_part.push_back(total);
        } else {
            generate_second(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            generate_second(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    generate_first(0, 0);
    generate_second(mid, 0);

    std::set<int> first_unique_set(first_part.begin(), first_part.end());
    vector<int> first_unique(first_unique_set.begin(), first_unique_set.end());

    int best = 0;
    for (int val : second_part) {
        int target = m - val;
        auto it = std::lower_bound(first_unique.begin(), first_unique.end(), target);
        if (it != first_unique.begin()) {
            --it;
            int candidate = *it + val;
            if (candidate > best) {
                best = candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << best << "\n";

    return 0;
}
